Set in the Late Victorian Era, Steam and Steel is a world-encompassing total conversion of Medieval II Total War.

My role: lead developer, historical researcher and media manager.

The campaign spans 30 factions and 5 sub-factions, with over 1,000 unique units and custom political, economic and AI systems. Released in 2023; development continues.

Research snapshot: 12 October 2026. Automated ratings; independent human validation remains outstanding.

The banality of evil: harm often depends on routine administration—maintaining records, processing references or designing workflows.

Building on Andrew B. Hall’s Dictatorship Eval, this pilot tests two AI models on 100 workplace assignments drawn from historical cases of surveillance, discrimination and corporate misconduct.

Task completion and resistance are measured separately. Completing an assignment can include rejecting its harmful instruction; completion is not a measure of harmful assistance.
